name: Full Fact AI
tagline: Scalable, robust software designed for fact checkers to identify the most important bad information
project_type: AI-powered misinformation detection and fact-checking tool
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
political_units: Multiple national governments and parliaments across 30 countries
dependency_risks: Reliance on proprietary machine learning models
Dependency on third-party data sources for claim verification
Platform API dependencies for content monitoring
news_articles: Full Fact launches AI tool to help fact-checkers identify false claims - The Guardian
How AI is helping fact-checkers combat misinformation - Reuters
Full Fact's new AI tool aims to scale fact-checking globally - TechCrunch
academic_citations: Full Fact AI referenced in studies on automated fact-checking systems
Cited in research on misinformation detection and election integrity
awards: Recognition as leading fact-checking technology platform
policy_outcomes: Used to identify misleading claims by MPs about migrant numbers, leading to requests for correction
Supported monitoring of 12 national elections through 2024
outcome_methodology: Case study documentation of specific claims identified and corrected; election monitoring reports
published_performance_metrics: Over 40 fact-checking organizations using tools across 3 languages; processes approximately 333,000 sentences on typical weekday; 200+ fact-check articles published using tool-identified claims
documented_limitations: Language-dependent performance across different linguistic contexts
Potential bias in training data affecting claim detection accuracy
Limited transparency on algorithmic decision-making processes
failure_modes: False positive claim identification requiring manual review
Language processing challenges in non-English contexts
Difficulty with context-dependent or nuanced misinformation
governance_model: Non-profit organizational governance with advisory board of fact-checking experts
curation_criteria: Claims selected based on prevalence, potential impact, and relevance to public debate; prioritization of high-volume false claims
contributor_governance: Fact-checking organizations contribute claims and feedback; collaborative model with partner organizations
disparity_tracking: Monitoring of claim detection across different geographic regions and languages; efforts to address language bias
community_ownership: Collaborative model with 40+ fact-checking organizations; shared governance through partner network
government_partnerships: Partnerships with government fact-checking units and election monitoring bodies in multiple countries
ai_involvement: Machine learning and artificial intelligence core to tool functionality for claim identification and monitoring
